title: Return Merchandise Checklist
subtitle: Return Merchandise Movement: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Return Merchandise Checklist covers return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody. The returns coordinator records Return Merchandise Movement criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Return Merchandise Checklist keeps Return Merchandise Movement exceptions visible until the returns coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Return Merchandise Checklist at customer location, return dock, carrier route, quarantine zone, and disposition point. Document return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody identity before Return Merchandise Movement begins. Compare return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody findings with stated Return Merchandise Movement criteria; route unresolved Return Merchandise Movement issues to returns disposition reviewer.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Return Merchandise Movement, identify responsible parties, customer location, return dock, carrier route, quarantine zone, and disposition point, and the linked return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody source.

fields.label: Item, serial, lot, quantity, and package

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Return Merchandise Movement facts for return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Return Merchandise Movement inspection checks
items: Refund, replacement, repair, restock, or rejection routing

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Before closing Return Merchandise Movement, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Returns Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Financial outcome requested before condition review
blocks.guidance: Pause Return Merchandise Movement when authorization, identity, safe handling, custody, or disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Return Merchandise Movement proof and route unresolved return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody scope to returns coordinator.
